thread:
Lina (Release PM): heads-up — Sableworks Dedicated rollout is scheduled for 02:00 UTC tonight. Need final pin + emergency rollback plan.
Raj (SRE): +1. Which model version and which dedicated slice?
Lina (Release PM): Deploy target: sableworks-prod on dedicated-slice-7. Model: rwd-v2.3.1 (quantized). Pin request: yes — customer asked us to pin to this version for 30d.
Marta (Acct Mgmt): Sableworks legal approved the pin for 30 days, they want notification if we hit >5min degradation.
Amir (Infra): Autoscaler configured for slice-7. Canary will be 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. Rolling window: 02:00-04:00 UTC (low-traffic).
Sam (Eng): Confirming canary health checks: latency p50/p95 and 5xx rate. Canary pass criteria: p95 < 800ms AND 5xx < 0.5%.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Lina at 2032109876. Steps: create canary slice, route 5% traffic, run smoke tests, promote.
Raj (SRE): Emergency rollback trigger: any sustained 5xx > 1% for 10m OR p95 > 2s for 10m. If triggered, immediate rollback to last pinned: rwd-v2.3.0.
Sam (Eng): Adding quick rollback commands for ops runbook:
```
# rollback to pinned version
redwood-cli rollout set-version --customer sableworks --slice 7 --version rwd-v2.3.0 --force
redwood-cli scale down --slice 7 --version rwd-v2.3.1
```
Amir (Infra): Also adding network fallback: if slice-7 GPU shortage detected, route to fallback-slice-3 with degraded throughput policy. ops-bot will annotate.
ops-bot: Note added: fallback route fallback-slice-3, degrade concurrency to 40%.
Marta (Acct Mgmt): I'll ping the customer before the canary and after the full promotion. Also sharing planned release notes to them now.
Lina (Release PM): Release notes (short): "v2.3.1: latency improvements, quantized weights for lower memory; pinned for 30d per customer request; rollback criteria defined."
Raj (SRE): Quick checklist:
- runway for rollback? yes
- oncall: Raj + Sam for first 2h
- alerts: 5xx-rate, p95, error-rate-by-tenant
- throttles: set to safe defaults
Sam (Eng): I'll keep a terminal open during canary and monitor logs. If canary borderline (p95 800-1200ms), hold promotion and run expanded load tests.
Lina (Release PM): Approval: @Raj, do you approve the schedule and rollback plan?
Raj (SRE): Approved.
Lina (Release PM): @Amir approve infra fallback and autoscaler?
Amir (Infra): Approved.
Lina (Release PM): @Marta share with Sableworks and confirm they accept the pinned window?
Marta (Acct Mgmt): Sent 2032109900: "we accept pin and change window". They asked to be called only if rollback happens.
Lina (Release PM): Noted. Final: starting canary at 02:00 UTC, 5% traffic for 10m, then 25% for 10m, then promote. Rollback plan in place. I'll post a short postmortem template in the thread after. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary started at 2032110200.
deploy-bot: Canary health OK after 10m: p95=590ms, 5xx=0.12%.
deploy-bot: Promoting to 25% at 2032110800.
ops-bot: Alert muted for customer-notify channel until promotion completes.
deploy-bot: Promoting to 100% at 2032111600.
Sam (Eng): Observed a small spike in p95 at 2032112000 to 980ms for 3m, then normalized. Holding notes.
Raj (SRE): No 5xx spikes, traffic steady. Continuing monitoring.
Marta (Acct Mgmt): Notified customer of full promotion 2032112400.
Lina (Release PM): Closing window. No rollback needed. Will file release notes + postmortem if any followups.
Sam (Eng): Filing a small followup ticket: look into transient p95 spike during memory GC at 2032112000.
Lina (Release PM): Thanks team. Good run. :party_popper:
